description: Usuarios Servicio de Acueducto por Mes, Uso y Estrato - INGEAGUA SAS ESP is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by INGEAGUA SAS ESP, Cundinamarca. Cantidad de Usuarios del servicio de Acueducto en los municipios de Tocaima y Agua de Dios (Cundinamarca) provisto por INGEAGUA; discriminados por mes, uso y estrato. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher INGEAGUA SAS ESP, Cundinamarca. Its tags are empresa de acueducto, acueducto municipal. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible. The portal shows 2025-07-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
